picks.name: T-Shirt, charcoal
picks.why: A plain tee still underpins the office, date-night and everyday outfits and there isn't one owned yet. Regular fit in 200g organic cotton, made in the UK, no branding, with a sleeve that sits neatly rather than flaring. Charcoal goes tonal under a navy knit or the grey marl sweat, with the 502s and Sambas or the fawn chinos and brown Docs.

picks.name: 100% Merino Crew Neck Jumper, navy
picks.why: The office and date-night outfits still have no knit, and the Sunspel crew has sold out in L. A regular-fit fine-gauge merino crew with ribbed cuffs and hem: warm for winter but thin enough to sit flat under the Ashby without bulk. Wear it over the charcoal tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s for a date.

picks.name: Fleece Full-Zip Jacket, navy
picks.why: A winter mid-layer for photography walks and lounging, warmer than the sweats under the field jacket. Regular fit with a stand collar and plain front, no logo, so it zips neatly under the Parachute jacket or the Ashby. Pair it with the 502s and Sambas outdoors, or the navy relaxed chinos at home.
